rows.definition: tools/glm_witness_record.py is the pure-stdlib parser that turns a GLM-5.2 GPU-witness run log (the say() banners plus go test -tags cuda -v stdout emitted by tools/dgx_glm_gpu_witness.sh) into one structured content-hashed record under schema glm-gpu-witness/1 (tools/schemas/glm-gpu-witness.v1.json), stamping SHA256 over the exact raw log so the record is provably the one parsed from that log; its emitter identity is RECORD_TOOL glm_witness_record.py@1.
rows.distinction: It is the log-to-record PARSER for the GPU correctness witness, not the on-GPU proof runner itself (gpuServerGlmGpuWitness) and not taskmgr's WitnessRecord evidence struct attached beside a claimed state.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/importwitness.go implements the fak hooks import-witness hook verb (runHooksImportWitness): the cheap structural half of the tree-level build witness (#1325 acceptance criterion 2) that reads only the committed tree (git ls-tree plus one git grep at a rev, default HEAD) and flags each committed importer whose module-local target package has zero tracked non-test .go files, naming the exact git add that greens it; exit codes mirror the hooks contract: 0 clean, 1 IMPORT_OF_UNCOMMITTED_PACKAGE, 2 could-not-run fail-open.
rows.distinction: It is the userland hook FRONT DOOR and its verdict plumbing (importWitnessVerdict), not the internal/hooks gate_importwitness commit-boundary gate function that performs the same detection inside the hooks framework, nor the heavy compile-integrity pre-push gate that catches the failure only via a full go build.

rows.definition: INTEGRITY_REFUTED is the stable closed-vocabulary refusal name mapped to abi.ReasonIntegrityRefuted in coreReasonNames (internal/abi/reasons.go): the kernel denies a require-witness call when a registered witness resolver actively refuted the claimed effect, unlike UNWITNESSED where no corroborating witness was found at all.
rows.distinction: It is the serialized NAME of the refutation reason, not the Go constant ReasonIntegrityRefuted itself and not the resolver's abi.WitnessRefuted outcome value that the kernel folds into the denial.

rows.definition: The LaunchResult.LaunchWitness field (json launch_witness, internal/goalrunner/types.go) set by goalrunner's launcher: PLAN_ONLY tag=... run_id=... in dry-run mode and LAUNCH_WITNESS pid=... tag=... run_id=... after spawning (internal/goalrunner/launcher.go), the one-line machine-readable witness of what the launch actually did.
rows.distinction: It is the launch OUTCOME witness string carried on LaunchResult, not the PlanOnly option that produces the PLAN_ONLY variant, not the GoalLaunchReceipt persisted beside it, and not gateway-engine's kernel launch counter.

rows.definition: The exact cgo LDFLAGS linker-option token selecting libfakvulkan_v41_indexer_witness.a for the V4.1 indexer witness-tagged Go build: every Vulkan source file in internal/compute carrying the #cgo selector (vulkan.go, vulkan_ops_vulkan.go, vulkan_matmul_fused.go, vulkan_glm_kda.go, vulkan_device_sync.go, vulkan_device_debug.go) chooses this input exclusively under the v41_indexer_witness,!v41_bf16_boundary_witness,!v41_logit_scale_witness,!v41_tail_rope_exact_witness tag combination.
rows.distinction: It names the LINKER INPUT for the indexer witness archive, separately from the v41_indexer_witness Go build tag and its native/shader define; like its BF16-boundary, logit-scale and tail-RoPE siblings, the option alone does not prove linked bytes.

rows.definition: The issuepolicy contract refusal constant (internal/issuepolicy/contract.go) whose wire value ISSUE_CLOSURE_WITNESS_MISSING marks an issue whose closure claim lacks the required closure witness standard; devcmd's discoverability repair action for it is 'add closure witness standard' (internal/devcmd/issue_discoverability.go).
rows.distinction: It is the MISSING-closure-witness contract refusal, not its MISMATCH twin (a closure claim present but contradicted by the witnessed standard) and not the shipgate REFUTE cross-model audit verdict.

rows.definition: The issuepolicy contract refusal constant (internal/issuepolicy/contract.go) whose wire value ISSUE_CLOSURE_WITNESS_MISMATCH marks an issue whose closure claim contradicts the declared closure witness standard; devcmd's discoverability repair action for it is 'reconcile closure claim with witnessed standard' (internal/devcmd/issue_discoverability.go).
rows.distinction: It is the MISMATCH closure-witness contract refusal (claim present but contradicted), not the MISSING twin (no closure witness standard declared at all) and not the shipgate REFUTE cross-model audit verdict.
